## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle-concurrent.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Concurrent fixture passes 3 consecutive runs (no flake)
- [ ] Both n=1 and n=2 entries present in cycles[] after concurrent run
- [ ] Both processes exit with code 0
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle-concurrent.sh → PASS
- [ ] ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py → PASS (if edited)
